sites.enforcement_snippet:
if current > self.limit:
    raise RateLimitExceededError(f"Rate limit of {self.limit} exceeded for {client_ip}")

domain_notes: record_request increments a per-client counter and rejects once it exceeds the limit, guarded by a single comparison. Both existing tests stay well under the limit (1 request, then 6 against a limit of 60); neither drives the counter past the limit, so the over-limit rejection path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected record_request because its limit comparison is the sole enforcement and no test exceeds the limit.
